planets.name: TOI-198 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-198 with a 10.2-day year, found in 2023.

text.card: TOI-198 b was found in 2023 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-198. Its orbit and size follow Zapatero Osorio et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.
